title: Arrears on a Granite Ridge Pass Account: Withdrawal and Restoration of Scanning Privileges
content:
A pass account that stands in arrears loses its scanning privileges rather than its contract.

**The arrears position.** The arrears position is the amount still to be collected that is already past its scheduled date.

**When privileges are withdrawn.** Scanning privileges are withdrawn only once the tolerated arrears period has run out counted in calendar days from the day the earliest unsettled instalment was refused. Calendar days are counted forward from the anchor date, the anchor date itself counting as day zero, every day of the week counting alike, and a calendar day is never mixed with a full 24-hour period; where the resulting boundary falls on a date that does not exist in the target month, the last day of that month is used. The comparison is not-earlier-than and the boundary day itself satisfies it.

**The second route into review.** A pass is also brought into suspension review once refusals on it in the rolling review window reach the tier's tolerance, whether or not the arrears period has run out. That window is the 90 calendar days ending on the handling date, counted as the refusals recorded against the pass inside it.

**What suspension leaves standing.** A suspended pass keeps its tier, its price and its schedule; only admission stops, and the remaining instalments continue to be presented.

**When privileges come back.** Privileges are restored only when the pass account records show every refused instalment settled.

**The charge for restoring them.** The clause reading "Restoration places the tier's reinstatement fee on the pass account, and that fee is not charged where the refusal was the collective's own error" is **no longer in force**. It has been superseded, and what is placed on the pass account when scanning privileges are restored is now governed by the current basis for a restoration charge. The reinstatement fee published for each tier in this charter is unaffected and remains in force as the tier's published figure.

**More than once in a season.** A pass may be suspended and restored more than once in a season, and each restoration carries its own fee.

### The arrears clock on a Granite Ridge Local Pass

That tier tolerates 3 refusals in the rolling window and carries an arrears period of 28 calendar days.

| Hypothetical position on the handling date | Clause on withdrawal |
| --- | --- |
| earliest unsettled instalment refused 27 calendar days ago, 1 refusal in the window | the arrears period has not run out and the tolerance is not reached |
| earliest unsettled instalment refused 28 calendar days ago, 1 refusal in the window | the arrears period has run out; the boundary day satisfies it |
| earliest unsettled instalment refused 9 calendar days ago, 3 refusals in the window | the tolerance is reached and the pass is brought into suspension review whatever the arrears clock shows |

superseded_clauses: Restoration places the tier's reinstatement fee on the pass account, and that fee is not charged where the refusal was the collective's own error.
